code_refs.spanning_chain_edges: amounts.py:117-118, split.py:62-63, cadence.py:70-72, gas.py:113-115, funding.py:119-120 — a group is emitted as a chain over SORTED addresses, so the component is welded regardless of which member is actually suspicious

code_refs.sequence: sequence.py:20 MAX_BLOCK_GAP=2; :61-65 near() only vs the PREVIOUS member (drift), min run = cfg.min_size = 5; :36 includes multi-deposit wallets
code_refs.gas_component_wide: gas.py:97-105 rule, :113-115 chain over every member; docstring gas.py:3-8 concedes 0.035 gwei is a common honest default
code_refs.funding_hub_N2: funding.py:102-103 `len(funded) < 2` and :110-111 `len(members) < 2` -> a hub of TWO wallets is a family; infra list labels.py:25-48 = 12 CEX hot wallets + 2 entry points
code_refs.peel_same_component_only: funding.py:89-90 `comp == component_of.get(funder)` — a peel chain that crosses two tier-A components (different amount windows) yields nothing (the 96-100 ETH ring)
code_refs.multi_deposit_exemption: signals/__init__.py:68-78 single_first_rows; amounts.py:96, split.py via windows, cadence.py:46 — every amount/cadence rule skips wallets with >=2 deposits; only sequence.py sees them
